Name: Squishy / Absorption
Does Not Automatically Protect Against: Cuts, Acid, Static, Soul, heat/Burn, Mucus control, Bleed ticks, statuses.
Limits / Counterplay: Proportional, blunt only. Keep distinct from Shell's fixed per-layer reduction; big hits still feel big.
Method: Proportionally reduces blunt physical impact (Force) and may reduce knockback and collision impulse.

Name: Membrane
Does Not Automatically Protect Against: Already-applied statuses and hazards. A status is prevented only if its applying hit is blocked.
Limits / Counterplay: Show Membrane damage and recharge clearly (blue; on the player, the armour bubble). Static recharge is +25% capacity, once per 5 s. Force resistance is measurable, not immunity.
Method: A separate pool absorbs eligible direct damage before health and regenerates after a short spell without Membrane damage. Force drains it less efficiently and knocks back less while it is up.

Name: Shell
Does Not Automatically Protect Against: Burn/heat, Mucus control, Bleed ticks, Soul build-up, statuses.
Limits / Counterplay: One brown ring per layer; layer loss always visible. Ordinary hits wear a layer slowly, a full Corrosion bar strips one, a heavy Force hit knocks one off at once. Lost layers stay gone for the encounter.
Method: Finite layers, each subtracting a fixed amount from qualifying physical hits and each with a little health.

Name: Thorns
Does Not Automatically Protect Against: Ranged attacks, hazards, non-contact effects, Evasion misses. Gives no protection from the hit itself.
Limits / Counterplay: Once per connected Contact hit, never per damage component. Bleeding or charged retaliation is a named variant, not baseline.
Method: Returns a bounded amount of damage when a qualifying Contact hit connects.

Name: Evasion
Does Not Automatically Protect Against: Burst, Beam and Pool (always land); existing statuses and hazards.
Limits / Counterplay: Visible "miss" puff on every miss. Spread rolls per pellet. Keep the chance well below half. (Formerly Dodge.)
Method: A miss chance against Contact, Projectile and Spread hits; a miss avoids the hit and everything attached to it.
